items.quote: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people
items.contrast: The guards and people who made the noise Athaliah heard versus the officers and trumpeters she later saw beside the king.
items.reason: The passage explicitly identifies the guards and the people as the source of the noise that prompted Athaliah to go to the temple. The question clearly asks about that causal relation, not merely who was present when she arrived.
